method.cold: 15 fresh Bun processes, each using an exclusive initialized 48-file/3-list repository; first content mutation on a new kernel
method.warm: one exclusive initialized repository and kernel, 5 discarded warmup iterations then 15 measured iterations; selected paths restored to base outside every measured interval
method.timing: performance.now wall time; repository discovery, module loading, fixture setup, selected-file edits, and reset are outside the timed intervals; cold does not flush operating-system caches
method.counting: spyOn wraps every stagingGit call and forwards to the real bounded executor; every sample including warmups asserts three writes and one raw+numstat files query, per-file text +1/-1 and complete M-bucket +16/-16 statistics
method.percentile: nearest-rank P95; arithmetic middle median (mean of two middle values for even sample counts)
method.scope: explicit core entry only; excludes HTTP authorization, Worker startup and browser refresh

method.entry: createGitStagingListsService with its default executeGitStagingWork, action(stage) then files
method.samples: 15 measured iterations with one real service instance; every action and files request starts its own real Worker; selected paths reset to base outside every timed interval
method.timing: complete action(stage) and files Promise wall times, including fixture beforeWrite, Worker startup, messaging, real Git, and awaited teardown; imports, fixture setup, file edits, trace reads, and resets are outside the timed intervals
method.authorization: fixture beforeWrite authorizes only the fixture root by verifying its realpath and runs exactly once per stage; no HTTP authentication or application permission database is measured
method.counting: real Worker GIT_TRACE2_EVENT records exact add/write-tree/update-ref/diff sequence and raw+numstat argv; each sample also asserts per-file text +1/-1 and complete M-bucket +16/-16 statistics
method.scope: service-to-real-Worker measurement only; excludes HTTP and browser behavior and is not end-to-end user latency
